source_policy: SLI-curated public evidence snippets only; not the full national/provincial database. Upstream official sources remain publicly accessible at their respective websites.
rights_note: Each excerpt is newly authored from dated public-source observations. Original source publisher retains rights to underlying publications.
limitations: Not a generative AI model or prediction service.
Pro full-corpus RAG requires private source migration and authentication.
Publication dates and observed statistical periods may differ.
Absence of relevant evidence must never be replaced with invented figures.
Citations link to primary or original organizational sources; review official revisions.

documents.title: Indonesia · Rasio Gini Pengeluaran
documents.text: Rasio Gini pengeluaran BPS Maret 2026 nasional 0.368, perkotaan 0.387, perdesaan 0.296. Ini ketimpangan pengeluaran, bukan ketimpangan pendapatan atau kekayaan. Tanggal publikasi 2026-08-05; tidak dapat digunakan sendirian untuk menyimpulkan risiko investasi.
documents.text_en: BPS reports a national expenditure Gini ratio of 0.368 for March 2026, 0.387 for urban areas and 0.296 for rural areas. Publication date: 2026-08-05. This measures expenditure inequality, not income or wealth; it cannot alone establish an investment-risk ranking.

documents.text_en: 2025 provincial GRDP at current prices: 3,038,667.95 IDR billion (preliminary). documents.title: Integrated EV battery ecosystem
documents.text: Sektor: Critical minerals. Lokasi: Karawang, West Java; East Halmahera, North Maluku (multi-site). Status yang dilaporkan: Under construction. Investor/pihak: ANTAM · IBC · Ningbo Contemporary Brunp Lygend (CBL). Nilai diumumkan 5.9 USD billion, BUKAN belanja modal terealisasi. Sumber sampai 2025-06-29; bukan konfirmasi kondisi real-time.

documents.title: Cara membaca pertumbuhan, Gini, dan investasi
documents.text: Pertumbuhan riil PDRB dan Rasio Gini pengeluaran diukur pada periode berbeda, sehingga hubungan keduanya bersifat deskriptif dan tidak membuktikan kausalitas. PMTB adalah komponen pembentukan modal dalam neraca daerah, bukan realisasi proyek BKPM. Multiplier effect memerlukan data input-output dan model yang diuji; tidak boleh disimpulkan dari korelasi saja.
documents.publisher: SLI methodological interpretation of BPS publications
documents.title_en: Interpreting economic growth, Gini and investment
documents.text_en: Real GRDP growth and expenditure Gini are observations from different periods; comparing them descriptively does not establish a causal relationship. PMTB is an expenditure-accounting measure of capital formation, not BKPM realized project investment. A multiplier-effect estimate requires appropriate input-output data and a validated model; correlation alone is insufficient.
